title: Set Tipper Controller Parameters on Operator Station HMI (Visu_MDs F2)
summary: Use the operator station HMI to open the “Visu_MDs” screen (F2) and set the initial controller parameters for each tipper axis. Maintenance or admin login is required to change the settings.
when_to_use: When a tipper component has been replaced and the tipper needs to be re-commissioned by setting the initial controller parameters for each tipper axis.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Navigate the operator station HMI to “Visu_MDs” (F2) and set initial controller parameters for each tipper axis after logging in as maintenance or admin.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (operator station HMI)

access_required: Maintenance or admin login credentials (required to change settings)
system_preconditions: Operator station HMI is reachable and responsive enough to navigate to “Visu_MDs” (F2).

visual_references.description: Operator station HMI screen used for setting initial controller parameters during tipper commissioning (Visu_MDs).

steps.title: Navigate to the Visu_MDs screen (F2) on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the correct HMI screen used to set initial controller parameters for each tipper axis.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the “Visu_MDs” screen using F2.
steps.expected_result: The “Visu_MDs” screen is open on the operator station HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Visu_MDs” screen is accessible and displayed (not blocked/absent).
steps.failure_condition: The “Visu_MDs” screen cannot be accessed (screen does not open) or the navigation does not reach the “Visu_MDs” screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.2: SET CONTROLLER PARAMETERS. Set the initial parameters for each axis of the tippers. 1. On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_MDs" screen (F2).

steps.title: Confirm maintenance or admin login before changing settings
steps.purpose: Ensure the HMI allows parameter edits; the manual states maintenance/admin login is required to change settings.
steps.instruction: Confirm you are logged in as maintenance or admin (required to be able to change the settings).
steps.expected_result: The current login level is maintenance or admin, enabling the controller parameter fields/settings to be changed.
steps.healthy_condition: Controller parameter settings on the Visu_MDs screen are editable after login.
steps.failure_condition: Settings are missing/locked such that initial controller parameters cannot be changed.

actions.label: Verify login level
actions.exact_action: You must be logged in as maintenance or admin to be able to change the settings.

stop_or_escalate_if: Axis parameter fields are missing/locked in a way that prevents setting initial parameters

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: NOTE: You must be logged in as maintenance or admin to be able to change the settings.

steps.title: Set initial controller parameters for each tipper axis on Visu_MDs
steps.purpose: Complete the commissioning step by updating the initial controller parameters for each tipper axis.
steps.instruction: On the Visu_MDs screen, set the initial parameters for each axis of the tippers.
steps.expected_result: The initial controller parameters for each tipper axis are updated on the Visu_MDs screen (i.e., the settings were editable and changes were applied).
steps.healthy_condition: After editing, the Visu_MDs screen reflects updated initial parameter values for each axis.
steps.failure_condition: Edits do not apply (values do not change) or axis parameter fields are not available/editable.

actions.label: Edit axis controller parameters
actions.exact_action: Set the initial parameters for each axis of the tippers.

stop_or_escalate_if: Axis parameter fields are missing/locked in a way that prevents setting initial parameters

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.23.2: SET CONTROLLER PARAMETERS. Set the initial parameters for each axis of the tippers.

success_criteria: Maintenance/admin login is confirmed and controller parameter settings are editable.
Initial controller parameters for each tipper axis are updated on the Visu_MDs screen.
healthy_conditions: Axis parameter settings are editable after maintenance/admin login.
Updated initial parameter values are reflected on the Visu_MDs screen.
failure_conditions: Settings cannot be edited because login is not maintenance/admin.
Axis parameter fields are missing or locked such that initial parameters cannot be set.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot edit the settings, verify you are logged in as maintenance or admin.
Stop and escalate if the Visu_MDs screen cannot be accessed or if axis parameter fields are missing/locked in a way that prevents setting initial parameters.
